scope: Phase 10A macOS public primary-display capture through runtime/SDK with independent PNG decode and ScreenCaptureKit oracle after fixing product helper Swift compilation mode

immutableHistory.diagnosis: Two stale/test-only contract assertions and an oracle compile block prevented public capture execution.
All contract tests passed; public display.capture reached the product helper and failed because the product wrapper compiled its async @main Swift helper without -parse-as-library.

forwardFix.testGuard: display-capture.test.js requires the product wrapper to retain -parse-as-library

physicalOracle.reasonNotByteForByte: Separate real screen frames may legitimately differ because visible content can change between captures.

resultPolicy.BLOCKED: The macOS/Swift/ScreenCaptureKit environment or pre-existing Screen Recording permission prevents the physical checkpoint from running. No permission request is made.
resultPolicy.FAIL: The public runtime/SDK capture, PNG integrity, capability metadata, privacy boundary, or independent oracle observation is inconsistent.
resultPolicy.PASS: The public display.capture path returns a valid primary-display PNG whose metadata and decode agree with an independent ScreenCaptureKit/CoreGraphics oracle, without persisting or logging screenshot bytes.

nextStepOnPass: Promote display.capture to PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED in a separate product commit/evidence update, then continue Phase 10B pointer delivery discovery/fixture work without weakening semantic UI APIs.
nextStepOnBlockedOrFail: Preserve immutable evidence, diagnose forward, and create a new session ID. Do not promote Phase 10A on a non-PASS checkpoint.
